channel.title: CNN 5 Things
channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: Five Heroes, Five Remarkable Stories
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
CNN Heroes is celebrating 20 years of honoring everyday people doing extraordinary things. The 2026 CNN Hero of the Year will be announced next Saturday, December 5, during an All-Star tribute at 8 p.m. eastern.  

 In this special episode, we’re revisiting all five finalists. Vote here before Sunday night on November 29th and learn more about each of the Heroes and how you can support them here. 

Host/Producer: Krista Bo Polanco 

Producer: Eryn Mathewson 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Christie O'Reilly, Meg Dunn, Kathleen Toner, Allie Torgan, Omar Jimenez

item.title: The Army Blew Up Unstable Bomb-Making Chemicals. Now What?
item.description: The US Army detonated nearly five tons of unstable bomb-making chemicals in Iowa – are nearby residents confident they will be protected from lead exposure? Another government agency is investigating a cybersecurity incident. A plane crash near Mississippi’s Horn Island has killed all six on board. Trump is trying to bring his tariffs back – we'll tell you which countries are in the crosshairs this time. And Americans are expected to spend nearly a $1 billion more on gas this Thanksgiving, (no) thanks to the war with Iran. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Staff
item.description: Millions are on the move before Thanksgiving as storms threaten both coasts. Jensen Huang gets candid with employees in his first meeting back as Nvidia CEO.
